source.buildspec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
      - docker pull public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node:20.16.0-bookworm-slim
      - docker tag public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node:20.16.0-bookworm-slim node:20.16.0-bookworm-slim
      - docker pull public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx-unprivileged:1.27.1-alpine
      - docker tag public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx-unprivileged:1.27.1-alpine nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27.1-alpine
  build:
    commands:
      - docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/web:latest .
  post_build:
    commands:
      - docker push 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/web:latest
